evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/nfc/NFCAccessController.ts:380-388 (addToWallet) builds the Apple Wallet pass with three user-facing English string literals that never pass through react-i18next: `description: `${credential.buildingName} Access`` (line 385), `organizationName: 'Property Management'` (line 386), and `style: 'generic'` aside, the ' Access' suffix and org name render verbatim on the pass surface shown in the user's Apple Wallet.

The rest of this app is thoroughly localized via `const { t } = useTranslation()` (sk/cs/de/en per frontend/apps/mobile/CLAUDE.md i18n setup; e.g. every Alert in screens/documents/DocumentShareSheet.tsx uses t('documentShare.*')). A Slovak/Czech/German user provisioning a building-access credential to Wallet gets an English-only pass description — an i18n gap on a consumer-facing surface.

Reachability: iOS-only path (Platform.OS==='ios' && NativeWallet available, line 360), gated behind a real credential with encryptedData (line 375), so it is a genuine production path for iOS users, not dead code. Landable frontend-only fix: route buildingName-suffix and organizationName through t() (e.g. t('nfc.walletAccessSuffix'), t('nfc.walletOrgName')) with the four locale bundles, or pass a pre-localized label from the caller. Low severity: cosmetic/localization, no functional or security impact.

frontend/apps/mobile/src/screens/meters/MetersScreen.tsx:100 (toUiMeter) — `label: m.meter_number?.trim() || m.location?.trim() || 'Meter'` uses a hardcoded English literal 'Meter' as the fallback display label when a meter has neither a meter_number nor a location. That label is rendered directly in the meters list UI, so a Slovak/Czech/German user sees the English word 'Meter' for any unlabeled meter.

Consistent with the app's i18n convention (react-i18next, four locale bundles) every other user-visible string on this screen is localized; this fallback was left as a raw literal. Triggered whenever the api-server returns a meter with empty/whitespace meter_number and location (a legitimate data state — both fields are optional/trimmable in ApiMeter).

Landable frontend-only fix: replace the literal with t('meters.unnamedMeter') (add the key to the sk/cs/de/en bundles). Since toUiMeter is a pure exported mapper with no t() in scope, either thread the translator in or resolve the fallback at the render site. Low severity: localization gap on an edge-case label, no functional impact.
